user.title: Use an existing GWM vehicle
user.description: Select your already-configured Thailand GWM vehicle. This read-only companion does not request passwords, tokens, certificates or a vehicle PIN. Recording is optional and limited to seven rolling days.

data.record_journeys: Record private observations (seven rolling days only)

abort.source_missing: Set up GWM Thailand Connect first. This companion does not sign in to the vehicle cloud.
abort.already_configured: A tracker for this source vehicle is already configured.

init.title: Private journey observations
init.description: Retention is always seven rolling days. Disabling recording hides history and stops new observations; existing samples still expire. Use the card's confirmed deletion to erase them sooner.
